title: gx inside of a man page is broken

milestone.title: backlog
milestone.description: Low priority items. We plan to work on this but don't have a target date.

- Vim (version: ) behaves differently? Yes
- Operating system/version: macOS Sierra 10.12.6
- Terminal name/version: iTerm2 Build 3.1.20170801-nightly
- `$TERM`: `tmux-256color` in tmux, `xterm-256color` otherwise

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```sh
export MANPAGER="nvim -u NORC +'set ft=man' -"
```

Then open a `man` page, find a URL & in normal mode do `gx`

`:verbose map gx` returns this

```
v  gx            <Plug>NetrwBrowseXVis
        Last set from /usr/local/Cellar/neovim/HEAD-e13b4a2_1/share/nvim/runtime/plugin/netrwPlugin.vim
n  gx            <Plug>NetrwBrowseX
        Last set from /usr/local/Cellar/neovim/HEAD-e13b4a2_1/share/nvim/runtime/plugin/netrwPlugin.vim
```

If I test vim only with this `export MANPAGER="/bin/sh -c \"col -b | vim -c 'set ft=man' -\""` it works fine but I'm not sure if we can compare both with different commands like this.

### Actual behaviour
1- it failed & errored out
2- When I did `CTRL+C` to exit (`ESC` didn't work), it opened a random app (textedit)
3- Open a new buffer with a different file randomly I assume from history?

Here is a gif (click to enlarge)
![man](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/63876/29091437-418da8d6-7c83-11e7-8b71-6051fcc9c866.gif)


### Expected behaviour
- To open the URL in the browser, don't open a random app or a file.
